title: A useful incident update starts from shared evidence

steps.label: Observe impact

steps.label: Confirm the current state

method: Conceptual communication workflow. The accompanying fictional handoff compares20and6 minutes to orient a new responder; it does not establish a causal effect or universal update cadence.
alt: Five steps connect observed impact to audience-specific updates and later corrections.
